name: control-plane-proof-admissibility-gap-closure
title: Close control-plane and proof-admissibility DoD gaps with ProofStory validation
description: Create a parent lifecycle story to audit and close the remaining Global Lifecycle Control Plane and Proof Admissibility hardening gaps that were not fully completed by prior MVP/partial stories. The story must use the newly enforced ProofStory gates to prove that document milestones are not reduced to command-existence checks, and must explicitly classify implemented, partial, future, and missing capabilities before any DEV work starts.
